ValidationRule.description: Alerts user while changing owner of Scheduled Project task
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
NOT($Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.ProjectTaskValidations__c), NOT(ISCHANGED( pse__Status__c )), ISPICKVAL( pse__Status__c , 'Scheduled') , NSP_Create_Work_Order__c = True, NOT( ISPICKVAL( NSP_Dispatch_Region__c ,"" ) ) , ISCHANGED( NSP_Owner__c ) , NOT( $User.NSP_Profile_Name__c = 'System Administrator') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please update the owner using the field service board
